responsibility: Declares the condition-specific pieces of the sym-exec bit-expression model. It defines the condition_status enum used by symbolic state tracking to record whether a newly added condition is known true, known false, symbolic, or absent, and it introduces bit_condition, a bit_expression subclass that stores a relational tree_code between two value_bit operands for use in path-condition construction and inspection.
same_name_distinction: Declares the condition-specific interface and status enum for symbolic-execution conditions, including bit_condition and condition_status. Unlike sym-exec-condition.cc, this header introduces the types and API shape but does not implement copying, tree_code access, or operator-printing behavior.
